text:
alex_sales: Quick sync — Helix Health POC kickoff today. Need final sign-off on sandbox access, redaction approach, success criteria, and pricing assumptions. They want a PHI-free sample set and a 2-week eval. Can we do S3 presigned URLs + VPC peering for model calls? Also security questionnaire still has 6 unanswered items. @maya_se @sanjay_solutions @taylor_security @nate_infra @lena_finance

maya_se: I can own prompts/evals. Use cases: 1) clinical note summarization with redaction, 2) question-answering over de-identified records (RAG). Success criteria proposal: p95 latency < 350ms, accuracy/AUC on eval set >= 85%, redaction false-negative rate < 0.5%, cost per 1k tokens within estimate. Is that OK?

sanjay_solutions: For sample data ask for ~500 rows (mocked) + 20 long notes for stress tests. We'll run the eval harness with their prompts. For redaction, suggest ingest-time removal of name/SSN/email with token-level masking. Example redaction script snippet we gave customer:```python
import re
def redact(text):
    text = re.sub(r"\\b(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})\\b", "[SSN]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[EMAIL]", text)
    return text
```

taylor_security: We need to complete the questionnaire before any Private deployment. Critical asks: KMS key ownership (customer-managed required), audit log retention (90 days default for POC), and data-at-rest encryption. For hosted sandbox: minimize risk by requiring sanitized sample set only, no real PHI. Add this to the SOC/PCI section in the questionnaire.

nate_infra: VPC peering is doable for Private. For hosted sandbox recommended pattern: customer uploads to their S3 and shares presigned PUT/GET URLs to us, or we pull from a pre-approved S3 role. Example minimal bucket policy for presigned flow:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/helix-poc-role"},
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
    "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::helix-poc-sandbox/*"]
  }]
}```Need their account id + CIDR for peering.

lena_finance: Pricing notes — for a 2-week POC we usually offer $5k credits + usage overage at dev rate. If they want dedicated reserve for peak, add ~30% uplift on hourly to cover GPU availability. If the eval shows >1M tokens/day we should move to a short-term reserved seat. I can draft a one-pager.

alex_sales: Good. Remaining blockers: 1) customer to deliver redacted sample CSV by EOD Wed, 2) security questionnaire items answered by Helix legal, 3) infra details (account id/CIDR) for peering. Can we get owners?

maya_se: I'll own evals + prompts. Will prepare the prompt set and shared eval harness by EOD Tue.

sanjay_solutions: I'll own sample data checklist and provide a redaction validator script that flags potential PHI left in text. Will share link to validator.

taylor_security: I'll mark the questionnaire items and send back to customer with our recommended answers and the KMS appendix. Expecting Helix to sign MSA before Private deploy.

nate_infra: I'll draft the minimal VPC peering runbook and S3 policy template. Need Helix account id + preferred region.

lena_finance: I'll send POC quote and credits agreement today. If they ask about enterprise discounts, note that Dedicated pricing requires a 3mo min commit.

alex_sales: Perfect — two action items for me: follow up with Helix legal for questionnaire; get the redacted sample CSV link into this thread. If anyone runs into blockers ping me. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment window for sandbox infra is available Thu 02:00-05:00 UTC. Reply `approve` to schedule.

maya_se: approve

sanjay_solutions: approve

taylor_security: approve (pending questionnaire clearance)

alex_sales: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and post the sample CSV when I have it.
